images.name: hero
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original photography for a premium architecture and interior design studio website.
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial architecture magazine photograph, richly textured natural surfaces, plausible precise architectural geometry, cinematic yet honest photographic depth, no render sheen. Landscape 3:2 composition, full room scene, straight verticals, professional architectural photography.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
Primary request: a warm sophisticated living room with a curved ivory sofa and a round travertine coffee table, dark walnut joinery, huge tall arched windows with Paris and Barcelona Mediterranean architectural detailing. A sculptural pendant hangs naturally within the room, and an olive tree is visible through a window.
Lighting/mood: beautiful strong side sunlight and dimensional shadows, welcoming and composed, sunlit atmosphere.
Color palette: restrained cream, olive, tobacco brown.
Materials/textures: tactile ivory upholstery, porous pale travertine, walnut wood grain, quietly textured cream walls. Full scene with room to breathe and furniture integrated into the architecture.

images.name: suite
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original architecture portfolio project photograph, 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 image
Primary request: Create exactly one original photograph of "Sessiz Süit", a serene Mediterranean bedroom for a refined architectural portfolio.
Scene and subject: A low sculptural bed with softly rumpled ivory linen against a walnut headboard wall, travertine bedside tables, tactile cream limewash walls, and a tall arched window offering a partial view into a quiet olive courtyard.
Style and composition: Sophisticated editorial interior magazine photography. A thoughtfully framed room view with realistic proportions, straight verticals, physically plausible architecture and furniture, restrained styling, and rich natural textures. The image should feel photographed in a real built interior.
Lighting and palette: Delicate warm sunlight enters through the tall arched window, with soft natural shadow falloff. Warm cream, muted olive, tobacco and walnut tones; serene, intimate, understated.
Materials: Genuine linen weave, subtle limewash variation, walnut grain and porous travertine.
Constraints: Exactly one landscape image at 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 aspect ratio. No people, no text or lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI. No CGI sheen, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion, no impossible geometry.

images.name: architecture
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: architectural portfolio editorial drawing, 1536x1024 landscape 3:2
Primary request: Create exactly one architectural axonometric cutaway floor plan of a sophisticated single-storey Mediterranean courtyard house.
Style and composition: Precise clean fine black ink technical linework, axonometric bird's-eye angle, roof removed to reveal the plan, clear wall thickness, coherent rooms arranged around a courtyard, minimal chairs and table footprints, thin construction guide lines. The entire house and all drawing marks fit within the image, centered with generous margins.
Background and palette: Uniform flat light ivory #f4f3e9 background, black linework only. No other colors, no shading, no shadows, no paper texture.
Constraints: 1536x1024 pixels, landscape 3:2. Editorial architectural drawing, not photorealistic. Physically plausible and legible spatial geometry. No labels, text, numerals, annotations, logos, watermark, people or UI.

images.name: studio-portrait
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: fictional founder portrait for an architecture design portfolio, 1024x1536 portrait 2:3
Primary request: Create exactly one black and white editorial photograph of an invented adult male architect and designer, around 40 years old, with medium-length dark hair and a short beard, wearing a linen shirt.
Scene and subject: He sits casually in a sunlit elegant architecture studio beside material samples. Natural candid warm expression, relaxed and thoughtful presence.
Style and composition: Sophisticated restrained premium magazine photography, medium shot including his torso and both hands with anatomically realistic fingers. Rich photographic monochrome tones, authentic linen and studio material textures, subtle natural film character.
Lighting: Soft directional window daylight, plausible light and shadow, gentle facial modelling.
Constraints: 1024x1536 pixels, portrait 2:3. Invented person, no named or recognizable real person. Black and white only. No text, logo, watermark or UI. No artificial CGI or plastic skin sheen.
